business.description: VXL Instruments Limited is a company under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) as per NCLT order dated November 26, 2024. The Resolution Plan submitted by NG Organics Private Limited and Mr. Nitinbhai Govindbhai Patel was approved by NCLT on September 9, 2026. The company is currently in the implementation stage of the Approved Resolution Plan under a Monitoring Committee.

outlook.statement: The approval of the Resolution Plan constitutes a material development subsequent to the end of the Financial Year under Review and has a significant bearing on the management, operations and financial position of the Company. The consequential changes arising from the implementation of the Resolution Plan, including changes in the shareholding, management and capital structure of the Company, wherever applicable, are being undertaken in accordance with the terms of the approved Resolution Plan and applicable laws.

The Financial Statement, however, have been prepared on a going concern basis based on the expectation of a successful resolution process. The resolution plan has been approved by the Committee of Creditors and is presently pending approval before the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT).
